jamie: Hi payroll — noticed extra US withholding on my Nov RSU payout. I updated residency to UK in June and uploaded split-year docs. Can you check? cc @maria-payroll

maria-payroll: thanks, Jamie. Can you DM employee ID and attach payslip? Well pull the tax event.

payroll-bot: EVENT: RSU_PAYOUT recorded (id EVT-100431) for E-12987 on 2025-11-02. Flags: residence=UK, supplemental_withholding=Y, sync_snapshot=2025-11-01

maria-payroll: system shows supplemental was applied. Looks like the HR sync for that snapshot failed to update the residency flag for your row.
devon-finance: rough cash impact ~1.9k USD if we refund. We can cover via off-cycle. Add GL 6521 to the correction.

jamie: oh no. Will this affect year-end forms?
maria-payroll: possibly. Plan: 1) refund supplemental via off-cycle next week, 2) re-run payroll calc and update tax event, 3) if withholding was included in year-end export well file a corrected W-2 (W-2C). Opening ticket PR-3624 and will update here.
jamie: thank you — sending payslip now.
maria-payroll: got it. Refund scheduled for 2026-01-15 off-cycle; will confirm W-2 status after we review exports. If anyone else sees dual withholding on equity events, please ping payroll-triage.
